items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔加入巴西大奖赛发车排位罚单名单
items.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿将在巴西大奖赛中因新内燃机获得10位发车排位罚单。
items.originalTitle: Leclerc joins growing list of Brazilian GP grid peanlties
detailZh: 勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿将在巴西大奖赛中因新内燃机获得10位发车排位罚单。
新闻中提到，汉密尔顿的发车排位罚单消息在周六早上已经出现，但最初看起来法拉利可能会等待在拉斯维加斯更换新内燃机，这样可能会触发发车排位的下降。
但在第三次练习赛中确认，汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔都将更换今年第五台内燃机，这会自动触发10位发车排位罚单。
维斯塔潘的30位发车排位罚单确认也是因为他更换了新内燃机、排气系统、涡轮增压器和动力单元辅助部件（在其允许范围内），这意味着无论他如何取得资格，他都将从最后一排发车。
凯迪拉克的塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯也将获得新的ICE、涡轮增压器和MGU-K - 这将使他获得30个位置的网格处罚。
法拉利、维斯塔潘和佩雷斯将加入乔治·罗素，在巴西接受网格处罚。
罗素将服刑五个位置的网格处罚，正如他在周末之前确认的那样。
佩雷斯、维斯塔潘 - 30个位置（在网格的后面）
detailEn: Both Ferrari drivers will take 10-place grid penalties at Formula 1’s Brazilian Grand Prix for new internal combustion engines.

News of Lewis Hamilton’s grid penalty emerged earlier on Saturday, but it initially appeared Ferrari may wait for Las Vegas before team-mate Charles Leclerc took his new ICE, which would trigger a grid drop.
But confirmation came during third practice that both Hamilton and Leclerc would take a fifth ICE of the year in Brazil, automatically triggering a 10-place grid penalty.

Confirmation of Max Verstappen’s huge 30-place grid penalty also came as he’s taking a new ICE, exhaust, turbocharger and power unit ancillary component (within his allowance), which will mean he’ll start at the back of the grid regardless of where he qualifies.
Cadillac’s Sergio Perez will also take a new ICE, turbocharger and MGU-K - which will give him a 30-place grid penalty.
The Ferraris, Verstappen and Perez will join George Russell in taking grid penalties in Brazil.
Russell has a five-place grid penalty to serve, as he confirmed ahead of the weekend.
Perez, Verstappen - 30 places (back of the grid)
keyPointsZh: 原本法拉利可能等待在拉斯维加斯更换新内燃机，但最终确认将在巴西更换第五台内燃机。
维斯塔潘和佩雷斯也将因更换新内燃机、排气系统、涡轮增压器和动力单元辅助部件而获得30位发车排位罚单。
keyPointsEn: Ferrari initially considered waiting until Las Vegas to replace the new ICE for Leclerc, but confirmed they will do so in Brazil.
Max Verstappen and Sergio Perez will also receive a 30-place grid penalty for replacing new ICE, exhaust, turbocharger, and power unit ancillary components.
